title: Tibet House Japan Starts Three-Month Tibetan Language Class
author: Ngawang Tsepak
content:
Tokyo: Tibet House Japan started its three-month Tibetan language class on 1 August 2026, at the Tibet House office and online. The language class is aimed at helping introduce Tibetan language, culture, and history to the interested participants.

-Report filed by Office of Tibet, Japan
